players.product: AI colocation in retrofit data centers (NC-1 North Carolina 40 MW IT leased to Nscale; MTL-3 Montreal for Cerebras) plus GPU cloud services on NVIDIA B300 / Vera Rubin clusters

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus customer concentration (customer not named): the Initial Customer accounted for approximately 75% of revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2025 (approximately $12.6 million). In January 2025 WhiteFiber agreed to supply the Initial Customer with an additional 464 GPUs for eighteen months (approximately $15 million of annualized revenue, two-month prepayment), replacing a prior agreement for an incremental 2,048 H100 GPUs; the customer elected to defer commencement until August 2025. At the data center business, MTL-1 served 14 customers as of May 30, 2025 and no one customer exceeded 50% of data center revenue. In April 2025 WhiteFiber signed two additional cloud services agreements with DNA Holdings Venture Inc. (DNA Fund) for 104 and 512 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, raising DNA Fund's total contracted deployment to 1,192 GPUs; combined, the two agreements represent approximately $20.9 million of annualized revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Initial Customer approximately 75% of Q1 2025 revenue; 464 GPUs, approximately $15 million annualized revenue; DNA Fund April 2025 agreements approximately $20.9 million annualized revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus fleet and unit economics: as of June 30, 2025 WhiteFiber had approximately 4,500 NVIDIA GPUs deployed, with approximately 4,000 GPUs under contract; MTL-1 hosted over 5,000 GPUs, including NVIDIA H200s and H100s, on behalf of 14 customers. The company estimates the capital expenditure to develop a Tier-3 data center at between $7 and $9 million per gross MW, excluding a targeted real estate cost of approximately $1 million per gross MW, and models approximately $1.6 million in revenue per gross MW at an EBITDA margin of approximately 75%; it anticipates an average contract term of 30 months to 7 years for its AI and ML customers. In March 2025 it entered a strategic partnership with GPU marketplace Shadeform to offer on-demand NVIDIA B200 GPUs from April 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 4,500 NVIDIA GPUs deployed, approximately 4,000 under contract (June 30, 2025); capex between $7 and $9 million per gross MW

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus detail on the Cerebras colocation agreement (January 2025): a five-year agreement to provide Cerebras 5 MW (IT load) of built-to-suit data center infrastructure, to be fulfilled at MTL-3 (Saint-Jerome, Quebec); Cerebras was granted a right of first refusal to purchase additional power capacity that becomes available at MTL-3. WhiteFiber says Cerebras is launching six new data center sites in North America and chose WhiteFiber as its partner for its first Canadian data center. MTL-3 development costs were expected to total approximately USD $41 million.
quarterly_data.figure: 5 MW (IT load) for five years; MTL-3 development costs approximately USD $41 million
